name: Dominican law: the Constitution (2010, reformed 2015 and 2024)
label: Dominican Republic
acts: Constitución de la República Dominicana, votada y proclamada por la Asamblea Nacional el 26 de enero de 2010
Constitución de la República Dominicana, reformada y proclamada por la Asamblea Nacional Revisora el 13 de junio de 2015
Constitución de la República Dominicana, reformada y proclamada por la Asamblea Nacional Revisora el 27 de octubre de 2024
record_note: From the Constitution proclaimed on 26 January 2010 (in force 2010-01-26) to the reform proclaimed on 27 October 2024 (in force 2024-10-27); the Consultoría Jurídica del Poder Ejecutivo lists no later constitution on 2026-10-28, the day the data was retrieved and checked.

dates.time: 12:00 America/Santo_Domingo (UTC-4; no summer time in the record)

scope.when_absent: this corpus records no scope notes (no commit carries Applies:); the absence is not a statement that the change reaches every case

default_reach.rule: non-retroactivity: "La ley sólo dispone y se aplica para lo porvenir" (Constitución, art. 110)
default_reach.meaning: a law applies to the future only; it reaches back only when favourable to a person on trial or serving a sentence, and never to alter legal certainty arising from situations established under earlier law
default_reach.authority: Constitución de la República Dominicana (2010, 2015, 2024), artículo 110 (Irretroactividad de la ley)
